summary: FASE 3 (Destinasi Immersif + Scroll-Story + Peta Rute) testing completed successfully. All backend APIs and frontend features working correctly with no critical issues.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/public/destinations returns list with all Phase 3 fields (intro, highlights, itinerary, route_points, faqs, best_time, lat, lng, gallery, hotel_recommendations)
Backend: All 4 destinations (bali, bromo, yogyakarta, dieng) have complete Phase 3 data with route_points>=2, highlights>=1, itinerary>=1, faqs>=1
Frontend: Destinations page (/destinations) displays 4 destination cards with correct data-testid
Frontend: Region filter chips (dest-filter-all, dest-filter-bali, dest-filter-jawa_timur) working correctly
Frontend: Jawa Timur filter correctly shows only 1 card (Bromo), All filter restores all 4 cards
Frontend: Navigation from destination card to detail page working
Frontend: DestinationDetail page displays h1 with destination name and 'Waktu terbaik' badge
Frontend: ScrollStory component (data-testid='scroll-story') rendered with 5 story steps
Frontend: RouteMapInteractive (data-testid='route-map') Leaflet map rendered without errors
Frontend: Itinerary section (data-testid='dest-itinerary') displayed with timeline
Frontend: Hotels section (data-testid='dest-hotels') displayed with recommendations
Frontend: FAQ accordion (data-testid='dest-faq') working - toggles from closed to open
Frontend: Trip estimator widget (data-testid='dest-estimator') with prefilled destination field
Frontend: Trip estimator calculation working - displays total in Rupiah (Rp 4.440.000)
Regression: Home page hero section and trip estimator (data-testid='hero-trip-estimator') working
Regression: Fleet detail 360 photo sphere tour (data-testid='photo-sphere-tour') rendered without errors
Regression: Theme toggle (data-testid='nav-theme-switch') working - switches between light and dark mode
